Require plan.output for an interface-only component with no supported implementation.

Register two different component documents with the same URI identity and version through different aliases.
An interface-only reader passes declared output checks; inspect that evidence never becomes inferred or executed.
Parse JSON containing duplicate year keys; for a YAML implementation also exercise aliases, merge keys, and implicit date scalars.
An ODCS document combines two valid quality operators: the pinned corrected schema accepts it; the release comparison records its different result.
Add an unknown top-level component property named retryMagic; separately confirm a default annotation does not supply a required year.
Compare boolean true against numeric 1 and compare a decimal bound immediately above an exact decimal value.
An imported shared component and the root both declare orders; the imported component must bind its local dataset while /orders selects the root.
Project a imports b, which imports a; retain the import path in the failure.
Select a schema object name matching two objects, then separately verify that an exact stable ID takes precedence.
A required local property definition points to a missing file; a separate fixture forms a two-file definition cycle.
Check one imported project while a second known consumer project is excluded; the report must list uncovered consumers.
Remove all implementation references from the commerce components while retaining valid interfaces and dataset declarations.
Call a two-input transformation with orders supplied and customers absent, plus a separate unknown port extra.
Pass a literal object containing a parameter-looking key; its contents remain literal and null stays distinct from missing.
Omit required year even though its schema has default 2026.
A symbolic integer source admits 1999..2026 while the target admits 2000..2100; include finite-enum and exclusive-bound subcases.
Symbolic arguments participate in an unsupported whole-object conditional even though each individual primitive type matches.
Remove the customer_id column from an available dataset while the consumer lists that column with required false.
A nullable customer_id is supplied to a non-null input; enum labels match but their underlying allowed values do not.
A consumer requires physical decimal precision and a time-zone rule absent from the supported mapping.
Declare customer_id unique without testing rows; evidence must retain a declared assumption only.
One field is incompatible and another has an unknown physical type; the dataset comparison fails and retains both details.
Two named steps consume one another; a separate fixture references a nonexistent output port.
A design has two exports: one is correct and one omits an expected field; both receive results.
An opaque component has a declared output and no implementation; core can pass while a separately required inferred-output check is not run.
A missing producer blocks a dependent export, while an independent invalid argument is still reported.
Request an unrecognized URI-named policy rule with a valid extension-rule shape.
A rowIdentity annotation contains region twice and names a missing order_day field.
A SQL quality rule has no complete fieldDependencies metadata; separate cases declare a nonexistent field and valid dependencies.
A vocabulary policy selects /status with value retired while only draft and active are allowed.
A registered quality-bearing property definition has no consumers; warn without claiming the inherited rule was executed.
An invalid prerequisite must not be replaced by an empty object; independent documents still finish checking.
Select one design and require core.calls; include all its prerequisites and report excluded sibling consumers.
Many designs use the same file and definition; instrumentation records one parse per real path and byte digest.
Change component bytes but retain its URI identity and version in the candidate snapshot.
Rename reader argument year to fiscal-year; all three loaded designs are affected and their stale calls fail with dependency paths.
A candidate adds a required reader argument and weakens a promised output; distinguish input and output compatibility directions.
An override weakens minLength from 5 to 2; a separate unsupported custom restriction remains unknown and external consumers remain uncovered.
Two development builds share version 0.1.4 but have different source commits and wheel digests; their inventories must differ.
Change one followed shared-definition byte after locking; verification fails without rewriting the lock.
A saved plan uses a staged-file list; changing one file invalidates reused execution evidence even when the newest filename stays the same.
Repeat a locked check with shuffled discovery order; stable results match while timestamps remain in volatile metadata.
Attempt a required unsupported physical-type comparison; the instance is unknown with reason, evidence level, and applicability.
Reduce a report with a required failure and a required unknown; failed wins. Additional table cases cover optional failures and operational errors.
Hide all error messages in human rendering; the underlying failed results and exit code remain unchanged.
A report has declared, inferred, and executed checks; snapshot and missing-capability evidence remain separately visible.
A result uses a diagnostic code already assigned another meaning; release qualification rejects the reassignment.
Invoke check without execution flags while reader implementations contain deliberate import-time side effects.
Exercise malformed content, unreadable file, missing adapter, valid project, and invalid arguments; verify codes 1, 3, 2, 0, and 64 respectively.
Run JSON format with progress enabled and an invalid call; stdout is one valid failed report and progress is on stderr.
Request a two-export build when only one export is supported; no partial bundle replaces the previous successful bundle.
Discover a valid manifest next to an executable module that raises on import; a core inventory reads only the manifest.
Translate a dataset with unique keys and decimal precision while the target only preserves names and primitive types.
An ODCS backend cannot execute a requested custom quality rule; native lint success does not make that data check pass.
Configure a dlt discard policy without a quarantine writer; the receipt records available discard counts but no quarantine claim.
Compile a supported component, save plan bytes, consume them with explicit bindings, and retain input/output field order and type mappings.
The consumer accepts a plan but the standalone validator reports unresolved validity in loose mode; required standard validity is unknown.
An output has one duplicate row that a set comparison would erase; multiset comparison fails against independently expected rows.
A custom function declaration has no runtime implementation; requesting its execution cannot treat the declaration as executable code.
Interrupt a bundle build after generating one output; preserve the prior successful bundle and expose missing obligations.
Supply a reader output through a binding; mark the reader as injected, verify digests, and reject a duplicate origin binding.
A definition path or symlink resolves outside caller-permitted roots; no outside file or remote URL is read.
Arguments contain shell substitution text and an explicit secret parameter; values are passed structurally and reports redact the secret.
Exceed the configured artifact or reference-depth limit; retain partial diagnostics and return an operational error.

Cancel a fixture caller wait; retain configured failure evidence and original native operation identity. Remove only runner-owned temporary data after ownership is established. Do not infer native cancellation or remove protected candidates.
Supply a component with an unsupported mandatory DDK version even though its own artifact version is a valid SemVer.
An optional URI-keyed annotation is unknown; preserve it without changing core behavior or loading an adapter.
A first product release has passing offline, catalog, and SQL checks but has no executed saved Substrait fixture. Require the full first release profile set.
A fixture expected output was generated by the transformation under test; qualification rejects it as independent expectation evidence.
A release reports documentation-schema checks as runtime conformance results; qualification rejects the unsupported claim.
A release evidence bundle lacks exact dependency versions, unresolved checks, and fixture provenance.
An inherited pattern plus inline maxLength must preserve both restrictions for the selected resolver; compare release 1.2.9 and pinned main.

cases.scenario: Retain two original occurrences with equal content digests and different capture contexts. The catalog preserves both occurrences, their shared content reference, and the exact definition and source bindings.
Load contradictory observed values from the same authority for one version and scope. Report a conflict and retain the cited origins.
Resolve the commerce ODPS ports through the pinned schema and explicit selections of separate objects in one ODCS contract.
Resolve an ODPS port whose contract and version identify multiple registered objects but whose explicit object binding is missing.
Bind an ODPS port to the correct logical dataset at the wrong ODCS definition version.
Import an opaque externally assigned version and a separate byte digest. Preserve their native scheme and authority and resolve the representation against the same exact version.
Preserve a nested list element path and a literal field name containing a dot. Check the intended nested endpoint and accept a valid semantic self-relation.
Resolve a release-local virtual row position against a different release.
Validate a relationship that requires a two-part dated key but supplies only the document number.
Load valid check evidence for an older output under a different rule version. The current required check remains unresolved.
Attach a successful run receipt and a required check with no execution evidence. Keep discovery available and qualification incomplete.
Refresh from unchanged metadata in a fresh process. Reuse evidence at its original assurance level. Verify zero data-payload opens, copies or repeated checks and byte-identical outputs.
Move the publisher selection to a new release. An existing release-local binding and historical run continue to resolve the original inputs.
Display a valid empty published table, an unknown expected population, a confirmed absence, and an acquisition failure with distinct observations and access facts.
Require a catalog export whose adapter is missing. Preserve the prior complete output set and report the missing capability.
Generate a public catalog with a disclosure policy. Restrict private locations and evidence while retaining permitted version identifiers and public links.
Parse the generated DCAT JSON-LD with an independent reader. Navigate catalog, dataset, version and available distribution or service. Verify the current-version link against the cited selection.
Request discovery for a historical version with no advertised access. Preserve the version description and omit an available distribution.

Validate the job and observed run events and supported version facets against pinned schemas. Import the native and DDK events into one receiver, replay both, and verify that the same job, run, and physical datasets keep their original identities. Resolve the recorded input and output versions to exact native references.
Load only a declared job and a native run with an unresolved terminal outcome. Emit the declared job and supported observed events, and keep terminal coverage unresolved.
Change a loaded relationship and required quality rule while keeping the data and production definition fixed. Report affected consumers, required requalification and regenerated metadata.
Request assurance that all consumers were checked while one known consumer project is outside the loaded scope.

Build a catalog from definitions alone with no metadata adapter. Expose meanings, declared relationships and query examples. Keep availability and observed lineage unresolved and create no inferred current selection.

Build from a recipe whose authoring path is relative to the declaring document. Move the complete output set to an unrelated directory and remove access to the original project. Resolve the generated recipe locally and check that its SQL bytes match the original digest. Its checked use binds the requested exact input versions.

Load distinct public and preview selections for the same dataset plus a disjoint public selection for another dataset. Select the public authority and purpose and verify the two intended current versions. With no selector, emit no current links.

Select an authority and purpose for which two distinct current release records overlap on the same dataset. Reverse file order and vary observation times. Report ambiguity in either order and preserve the prior completed output set.

Read a terminal run with a partial input list and one separately retained source with no consumption evidence. Emit only the observed consumed version and keep the scope and partial coverage in DDK. Do not turn the unproven source into a run input.

Check a composite comparison with a small scalar fixture and independently expected matches and non-matches. Include a different calendar date, a padded textual key, unequal binary bytes, and each supported null policy. Verify the shared rule preserves types and exact values.
Load a valid versioned project rule and request a required check of its comparison. The evaluator is unavailable. Retain the relationship declaration and report the check as unknown.

Execute the local commerce workflow on independently authored inputs and expected rows. Check the design and one definition change; execute SQL and replay saved Substrait bytes through DocSpec; attach supported ODCS checks and OpenLineage to the exact saved-plan output. Resolve ODPS and DCAT and use the generated catalog to bind a checked query to that output. Include separate nested/scoped-identity cases; reject wrong versions, incomplete keys and missing evidence. Verify unchanged metadata refresh with no data-payload reads. Claimed intake uses the exact staged files; managed quality gates have their separate typed-operation acceptance.

Catalog generation and saved Substrait fixtures pass separately, but no reader binds a checked query through the generated catalog to the exact checked output of the same saved plan. The connected local demonstration remains incomplete.
Assemble once, count one read of each recipe SQL source, retain its exact bytes and all requested standard outputs, and verify that the atomic writer uses those retained bytes.
A required check is unknown. Return admitted definitions and companions with their unchanged check status, no publishable controls, and the previous complete output intact.
A contextual relationship does not resolve. Refuse structural admission and return neither catalog nor companion bytes.
Retain a recipe title, ordered notes, explicit positional parameter order, and resolved contextual relationships. Preserve actual query inputs without adding contextual endpoints.

Disclose selected nested and list field paths with necessary ancestors, types and nullability. Withhold unlisted siblings, native properties and the original private root object name; retain explicit partial-path scope.

Retain root and imported project extensions separately with exact declaring identities and namespace. Public extension access requires the exact source revision and explicit extension namespace grant.

The same virtual field supports a row-position identity and an additional unique key with identical path, type and scope. Resolve it once without inventing a physical ODCS property or losing the original key.
Two virtual declarations of one path disagree about type or scope. Refuse the relationship and catalog admission.

Load an external target without treating it as a local alias or fetching it. Retain the relationship, local import scope and unknown shared comparison; a required comparison keeps the build incomplete.

Changing recipe documentation or contextual endpoint meaning requires metadata and reader review. Actual input and production changes retain their stronger computation obligations; rule changes require qualification separately.
Change one scoped opaque project extension. Record the metadata change and unresolved domain impact without inventing a computation dependency.
An explicitly supplied profile establishes declaration support for fixed-width native byte keys while preserving ordered composite components and leaving observed matches and qualification absent.
A fixture-owned profile interprets exact versioned text-to-integer and list-overlap declarations from resolved ordered key definitions. DDK supplies no application rule names or data observations.
Support external digest-and-suffix reference construction while retaining the external namespace, not_assessed existence, and no version, run or qualification evidence.
Unsupported exact rule versions, rule identities, native types and external meanings remain required unknown outcomes with an admitted catalog but no complete output set.
A release-local virtual key used outside its release scope fails before the application profile can override the shared guard.
Untyped, malformed, unsupported-status or empty-reason profile results remain required unknown results and cannot generate a complete output set.
Capture the explicit profile source once per assembly, preserve its original digest and tool identity in catalog and lock, and accept an exact distribution pin without discovering source.
Refuse a public catalog whose selected profile ID is a private file URI without an explicit identifier grant; retain a safe public report, local provenance and the previous complete output.
An empty disclosure-only field path grants root descriptions only when descriptions are enabled, without exposing children, native properties or custom metadata.

Changed profile provenance or declaration assessments require metadata and reader checks only along actually assessed relationships. Preserve unresolved domain effects, unused profiles and relationships outside the snapshot without claiming computation reuse.
Reject incoherent profile provenance, mismatched assessment identities, unsupported assessment status or invented external existence during impact comparison.

Compare two actual generated public catalogs after a selected profile revision or source change. Retain permitted identity and redacted source, withhold private assessments and reasons, and preserve unknown assessment/consumer scope without fabricated reader dependencies.
